title: Microsoft 365 Copilot: assign Anthropic model access to specific users and groups
summary: The briefing passes: the admin paths, assignment limits, regional defaults, retention periods and December option changes are supported by Microsoft Learn. One background statement about the different model processors needs an additional citation.

claims.claim: Enforcement covers Copilot apps, custom Copilot Studio agents and experiences managed through the Power Platform admin center.

claims.claim: Claude models use a different processor from OpenAI models.
claims.quote: Anthropic is a subprocessor for Microsoft Copilot. ... OpenAI is a subprocessor for Microsoft Copilot.

claims.where: summary; Why it matters; Scope; controls[1].note; rationale: risk
claims.claim: Microsoft enables Claude models by default for most commercial-cloud customers outside EU/EFTA and the UK.
claims.quote: Microsoft enables Claude models on by default for most customers in commercial cloud (excluding EU/EFTA and UK).

claims.claim: The general regional default for Claude availability in EU/EFTA and the UK is disabled.
claims.quote: For these regions, the AI providers operating as Microsoft subprocessors setting for Claude models appears but the default is set to No users. These regions include the European Union (EU), the European Free Trade Association (EFTA), and the United Kingdom (UK).

claims.where: Why it matters; Risk assessment: Data exposure; rationale: risk
claims.claim: Claude models in Microsoft offerings are currently excluded from the EU Data Boundary.
claims.quote: Claude models deployed in Microsoft offerings such as Microsoft Copilot, Researcher, Copilot Studio, Power Platform, and Copilot in Microsoft 365 apps are currently excluded from the EU Data Boundary

claims.where: front matter: defaultState; Why it matters; rationale: risk
claims.claim: Microsoft does not state the new assignment control's default enforcement state, so defaultState is unknown.
claims.quote: Searched: AI provider user group assignment default enforcement state Anthropic Copilot. Read Assign AI provider access, Claude models from Anthropic, apps-only settings and Known issues; these state provider availability defaults, not a distinct initial assignment-enforcement default.

claims.claim: The apps-only setting is enabled by default for EU/EFTA/UK tenants created after March 25, 2026.
claims.quote: This setting is enabled by default for tenants in the EU, EFTA, and UK that were created after March 25, 2026.

claims.where: Why it matters; Governance guidance; Open questions
claims.claim: For EU/EFTA/UK tenants, All users for Microsoft 365 apps only is removed on December 9, 2026.
claims.quote: Starting on December 9, 2026, the following setting changes are taking effect: - The All users for Microsoft 365 apps only option will no longer be available.

claims.claim: A selection of All users for Microsoft 365 apps only changes to All users on that date.
claims.quote: If the All users for Microsoft 365 apps only option is currently selected, the selection will change to the All users option.

claims.claim: Tenants that have made no selection change to All users on that date.
claims.quote: If you haven't previously made any selection, your selection will change to All users.

claims.claim: Other selections, including No users, do not change.
claims.quote: If you've selected any other option, including No users, your selection won't change.

claims.claim: Microsoft Product Terms and DPA apply to Claude use with Anthropic as subprocessor, except models labelled Anthropic models with Data Retention.
claims.quote: Unless models are labeled "Anthropic models with Data Retention," the Microsoft Product Terms and Microsoft Data Protection Addendum (DPA) apply to the use of Claude models from Anthropic through Microsoft's enterprise Online Services.

claims.claim: Anthropic models with Data Retention operate under Anthropic's own terms.
claims.quote: Anthropic acts as an independent processor and use of Anthropic models with Data Retention is subject to acceptance of Anthropic's Commercial Terms of Service and Anthropic's Data Protection Addendum.

claims.claim: For Data Retention models, Anthropic stores most inputs and outputs for up to 30 days.
claims.quote: This means that Anthropic (not Microsoft) stores most inputs and outputs for up to 30 days before deleting them.

claims.claim: Content flagged for potential Usage Policy violations may be retained for up to two years.
claims.quote: If Anthropic's trust and safety classifiers identify potential violations of Anthropic's Usage Policy, Anthropic may retain content (inputs and outputs) for up to two years

claims.claim: Trust and safety classification scores for flagged content may be retained for up to seven years.
claims.quote: Anthropic may retain content (inputs and outputs) for up to two years and trust and safety classification scores for up to seven years.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; Governance controls
claims.claim: Data Retention models have separate Microsoft 365 admin controls and are off for everyone until a tenant admin explicitly opts in.
claims.quote: No users will have access to these models until the tenant admin explicitly opts in to enable use of Anthropic models with Data Retention.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; Governance controls
claims.claim: The tenant admin must also choose which users or groups can use Data Retention models.
claims.quote: The tenant admin must also choose which users (all or specific users or groups) can access and use these models.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; Governance guidance
claims.claim: Learn says Claude models are coming into the EU Data Boundary starting in December 2026.
claims.quote: Claude models from Anthropic are coming into the EU Data Boundary starting in December 2026.

claims.where: controls[0].note; controls[1].note; Risk assessment; Scope; Governance guidance; Governance controls
claims.claim: AI Administrator or Global Administrator is required to change the Microsoft 365 provider settings.
claims.quote: You must be a member of the AI Administrator or Global Administrator role to perform this task.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.model and notes; Cost and licensing; rationale: cost
claims.claim: The assignment is an included option within Microsoft Copilot, whose general requirement is a Microsoft Copilot licence and qualifying prerequisite licence.
claims.quote: Users need a Microsoft Copilot license and a qualifying prerequisite license.

claims.claim: Microsoft Copilot Chat is available with an eligible Microsoft 365 subscription.
claims.quote: Microsoft Copilot Chat is available to users with an eligible Microsoft 365 subscription.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; Open questions; rationale: cost
claims.claim: The Anthropic and provider-assignment pages publish no separate Claude licence, price or meter as of November 2026.
claims.quote: Searched: Anthropic Claude Copilot separate license price meter licensing; "Claude" "Copilot" "license" "price". Read Claude models from Anthropic, Assign AI provider access, Copilot requirements and overview; no separate charge or entitlement for the assignment option is stated.

claims.where: Cost and licensing; controls[1].note; Governance controls
claims.claim: Microsoft 365 provider enablement does not automatically make models available in Power Platform.
claims.quote: Then, a Power Platform system admin allows the provider's models in an environment or environment group. Enabling a provider in Microsoft 365 doesn't automatically make its models available in Power Platform.

claims.where: controls[0].ui; rendered first table row; Governance guidance
claims.claim: The assignment path is Microsoft 365 admin center > Copilot > Settings > View all > AI providers operating as Microsoft subprocessors > Available subprocessors for your organization > Anthropic > Choose who can access Anthropic models for Copilot and generative AI experiences.
claims.quote: select Copilot > Settings > View all. ... under Available subprocessors for your organization, select Anthropic, and Save. ... Under Choose who can access Anthropic models for Copilot and generative AI experiences, select your users or groups and Save.

claims.where: controls[1].ui; rendered second table row; controls[1].note; Governance controls
claims.claim: The disable path is Microsoft 365 admin center > Copilot > Settings > User access > AI providers operating as Microsoft subprocessors > Available subprocessors for your organization > Disable Anthropic as a Microsoft subprocessor.
claims.quote: On the User access page, select AI providers operating as Microsoft subprocessors. ... under Available subprocessors for your organization, select Disable Anthropic as a Microsoft subprocessor. ... users won't have the option to use Claude models.

claims.where: controls[0].api; controls[1].api; rendered table; Open questions
claims.claim: No Microsoft Graph or PowerShell operation is documented for assigning Anthropic provider access or disabling the provider as of November 2026.
claims.quote: Searched: Microsoft Graph beta copilot admin settings Anthropic provider access assignment enable disable PowerShell; "copilotAdminSetting" "Anthropic"; "Anthropic" "PowerShell" "subprocessor". Read copilotAdminSetting reference (only limitedMode), provider access and Claude settings pages.

claims.claim: External models are allowed at Power Platform admin center > Manage > Environments > environment > Settings > Product > Features > applicable model provider setting (On or Off).
claims.quote: select Manage. ... select Environments, and then select the environment. ... select Settings. ... select Product > Features. ... turn each applicable model provider setting On or Off.

claims.claim: Environments in an environment group must be Managed Environments.
claims.quote: Environments in an environment group must be managed environments.

claims.claim: Unassigned users of Anthropic-based Copilot Studio agents added to Microsoft 365 Copilot or Teams receive an Agent Blocked error.
claims.quote: An agent that you add to Microsoft 365 Copilot or Microsoft Teams returns an "Agent Blocked" error in response to prompts. ... Users who aren't granted access to the model receive the "Agent Blocked" error.

claims.claim: Disabling Anthropic as a Microsoft subprocessor removes the option to use Claude models for users.
claims.quote: Once you disable Anthropic as an AI subprocessor, users won't have the option to use Claude models.

claims.claim: Claude models can be enabled again later after disabling the provider.
claims.quote: You can choose to enable Claude models at a later date if desired.

claims.claim: A Power Platform system admin separately allows the provider's models in an environment or environment group.
claims.quote: Then, a Power Platform system admin allows the provider's models in an environment or environment group.
